name: Domain Focus
body:
With prayer and practice you have become more deadly with your domain spells, making their effects harder to resist for your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Domains class feature.

Benefit: Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against spells from your domains. This also increases the Difficult Class for saving throws against domain powers.
